summary.en: Open-source remote desktop; the 1.5.3 release ships Windows aarch64 .exe and .msi installers.
summary.zh-TW: 開源遠端桌面軟體；1.5.3 版提供 Windows aarch64 的 .exe 與 .msi 安裝檔。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Only the presence of the aarch64 installers was confirmed; runtime behavior is untested.
caveats.zh-TW: 只確認有 aarch64 安裝檔，執行行為尚未驗證。
